notes: This is a comprehensive discovery queue, not a completed legal register or legal opinion.
Every listed country or area remains not assessed and blocked from release.
The UN M49 list is maintained for statistical use and does not determine territorial status or legal jurisdiction.

ISO alpha-2 identifiers have been cross-checked against the official UN M49 Overview ISO crosswalk; review country naming and inventory scope against the current ISO Online Browsing Platform, identify applicable subnational laws, and obtain qualified local review before launch.

isoCodeCrosswalk.method: Matched each project M49 code and ISO alpha-3 code to the official English M49 Overview table, then recorded its ISO alpha-2 code.
isoCodeCrosswalk.limit: Country/area identifiers only. No legal applicability, country-name scope, subnational law, or release status was assessed.
